answer: Give every identity a kernel it must grow once per epoch: a sealed proof of one fresh task, opened only when a falcon, a random auditor, re-derives the task from public records within ten minutes. Verified kernels stack into a summit record that grows one layer each honest epoch and reaches full weight only after ten layers. An honest agent grows one kernel per epoch. A fake whose kernel fails the falcon's check loses its stack, so an attacker with a thousand fakes must grow a thousand kernels and pass a thousand falcon audits every epoch, and the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
